lean_frontend/lakefile.toml.text:
name = "CerberusLean"
defaultTargets = ["CerberusLean", "cerberus-lean"]
moreLeanArgs = ["-DautoImplicit=false"]

# LemLib is the Lem runtime library for Lean, from the lem-lean fork
# (repo migrated septract -> OathTech 2026-08 [USER 2026-09-02]; the offline
# redirect in deps/gitconfig covers both spellings, so resolution is unchanged).
# arc-8 close: pinned to the MERGED mdd/lean-backend head (arc-8 pin dance;
# DAEMON/DAEMON1/legacy failwith removed from LemLib in this lineage);
# arc-10 S2: bumped to the arc/robustness lem head (Sum BEq/Ord, R1 +
# comparison derivation backend); re-pin to the merged head at arc close.
# effect-retirement C1: bumped to the arc/effect-retirement lem head
# (L0 fix-first + L1 supply/reader_consumer/fuel-budget features +
# audit response); C2: bumped to the L2 deletion head (runEffectful
# axiom + effectful mechanism retired — LemLib declares ZERO axioms);
# re-pin to the merged head at arc close (pin dance).
# pin-bump 2026-09-03: bumped to the merged mdd/lean-backend head 3c88f0d
# (the parity-fix arc: OCaml-order derived Ord, Pset/Pmap verbatim ports,
# right-to-left draw order, lem* deep-list rewrites, division-by-zero
# panics; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-03_parity-fix-record.md).
# fuel-parameter C1 2026-09-04: bumped to the merged mdd/lean-backend head
# 742506d (the fuel-parameter + structural + fuel-measure arcs: fuel is the
# `[LemFuel]` class instance, `lemDefaultFuel` and the numeric budget form
# deleted, generated `_lemFuel_zero` lemmas, `fuel_consumer`/`structural`/
# `fuel_measure` declares; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-04_fuel-
# parameter-record.md; this repo: docs/2026-09-04_fuel-parameter-C1-record.md).
# … then to the merged head ecf75b4 (the D2 enablers: backend-derived
# `t.lemSize` structural sizes, `lemSize x` fuel measures, fuel-lifted
# `inductive R [LemFuel]` for indreln premises; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/
# 2026-09-04_d2-enablers-record.md) — the pin at which the real tree generates.
# fuel-parameter C3 2026-09-05: bumped to the merged head d4ba548 (the
# tails-and-pmap-laws slice: a measured/structural definition's trailing
# lambda binders are hoisted into the head on the Lean target — `lemTail`
# for a `function` scrutinee — so the six point-free tails can carry a
# `fuel_measure`; `LemLibPmapLaws`; the reserved-name capture check on
# target_rep text; lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-05_tails-and-pmap-laws-
# record.md; this repo: docs/2026-09-05_fuel-parameter-C3-record.md).
# fuel-parameter C4 2026-09-05: bumped to f6542f8 (the measure-hypothesis
# slice: `declare {lean} fuel_measure val f = `μ` assuming `H`` — the
# obligation gains the reserved `lemHyp : H` binder immediately before
# `lemFuel`, the wrapper stays fuel-free; the UTF-8 letter-like tokenizer
# and the projection-on-non-parameter refusal in the measure renderer;
# lem-lean doc/lean-backend/2026-09-05_measure-hypothesis-record.md; this
# repo: docs/2026-09-05_fuel-parameter-C4-record.md).
[[require]]
name = "LemLib"
git = "https://github.com/OathTech/lem-lean"
rev = "f6542f8e6860d12d4655e6648bc4c45dabd1d798"
subDir = "lean-lib"

[[lean_exe]]
name = "cerberus-lean"
root = "Main"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

# Test library: tests live under lean_frontend/test/ and import from
# the main CerberusLean lib. Each test exe has root "Unit.<Name>Test".
[[lean_lib]]
name = "CerberusLeanTest"
srcDir = "test"
globs = ["Unit.+"]

[[lean_exe]]
name = "core-parser-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.CoreParserTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

[[lean_exe]]
name = "effects-proof-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.EffectsProofTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

[[lean_exe]]
name = "totality-proof-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.TotalityProofTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

[[lean_exe]]
name = "fresh-int-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.FreshIntTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

# arc-10 S3: pretty-printer mirrors vs recorded oracle outputs (OCaml
# string_of_float / %.*f transcript + Pp_core_ctype / pp_value shapes).
[[lean_exe]]
name = "pp-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.PPTest"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

# FUEL arc (2026-09-03): the consumer-shaped exemplar theorem over the
# shipped fuel-parametric pipeline (CerbND.drive_lemFuel), kernel-checked
# at compile time; main reports success. Design:
# docs/2026-09-02_fuel-arc-design.md §1.4/§6.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "fuel-exemplar-test"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.FuelExemplar"
moreLinkArgs = ["native/md5.o"]

# FUEL arc C2 (2026-09-04): the (A)/(B)/(C) classifier of every fuel'd worker
# (test/Unit/FuelFormsTool.lean) — a RUNTIME instrument over the compiled
# environment (importModules), driven by scripts/check_fuel_forms.sh, which is
# the policy + plants (test_unit.sh runs it). Not a compile-time proof exe.
[[lean_exe]]
name = "fuel-forms-tool"
srcDir = "test"
root = "Unit.FuelFormsTool"
supportInterpreter = true
